learning_outcomes.text: To use technical drawing (by hand) as a design and communication tool: 2D plan and simple perspectives (cavalier and axonometric).

To build a kinematic model of a mobile robot, to compute internal efforts of a simplified robot model, to measure torques and internal frictions, to measure power and work produced by robot motors, to establish a balance of electrical and mechanical energy.
To develop and test a JAVA program that allows the robot to perform, at scale, arbitrary maneuvers and trajectories.
Working in team to carry through an engineering-type project.
Communicate verbally in an efficient manner.
Communicate in writing in an efficient manner.
Self-appraise with respect to target training objectives in order to progress.

syllabus_topics: Propose a design based on specifications
Model the physical behavior of the machine
Simulate the behavior of the machine
Create illustrations to communicate the behavior of the machine
Prepare a summary and present it orally
teaching_methods: Flipped classroom with resources on Moodle
Weekly course for questions and answers
Weekly meetings with a tutor for student teams

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation in a team with synthetic visual support
Individual exam on skills and knowledge acquired in relation to disciplinary concepts

assessment_rules: The use of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools is tolerated if used responsibly and in accordance with academic and scientific integrity practices. Students must systematically indicate all parties using AI (e.g., in a footnote specifying its use for information search, drafting, or correction). Sources must be systematically cited, and students remain responsible for their production's content, regardless of the sources used.
bibliography: All project documentary resources are available on Moodle.
degree: Bachelor in Engineering (Bachelier en sciences de l'ingénieur, orientation ingénieur civil) - FSA1BA
